look.why: A cool watery cyan, the complement of the pink skin: the lake it should be living in.

size.measure: snout to tail tip: about 23 cm on average, some over 30 cm

habitat.text: The canals of Lake Xochimilco in Mexico City, high in the mountains. Its other lake was drained.

diet.text: Snails, worms, insects, small fish and even other axolotls!

facts.text: It keeps its feathery baby gills all its life and is famous for regrowing lost body parts.
Almost every lab axolotl descends from just 33 shipped from Mexico to Paris in 1864!
